I am farming here in Mbeya, and thanks to God the rains are usually good in our highlands. This small maize plot is only 0.16 hectares, but maize is our food and also what I sell when the harvest is plenty. I will buy some urea and DAP if the price is not too high this year, because without fertilizer the yield is poor, and I also put manure from my few animals. I use improved seed when I can afford it because it gives better cobs, and I intercrop with beans as we always do. I don't have irrigation — we depend on the masika rains — and I do most work myself with my family, hiring only a few people for weeding when the grass is heavy.
